title: Passenger overstates the delay; evidence shows just under threshold
narrative: We were six hours late, easily. It was a nightmare. I want the full amount for the distance.

documents.content:
BOOKING LU3390 — Passenger: V. MOREAU (adult)
Carrier: Lumen Air (LU)
LU740  LYS 06 Apr 2026 07:30  ->  IST 06 Apr 2026 11:50
Great-circle distance LYS-IST: 1,970 km.
Status: CONFIRMED.
BOARDING PASS LU740 06APR2026 — MOREAU/V — seat 18E — boarded 10:20Z

IST ARRIVALS — LU740 06APR2026
Scheduled on-blocks 11:50 local
Actual on-blocks 15:10 local
Delay at final destination: 3h 20m
Source: airport arrivals database extract, 06 Apr 2026.

LUMEN AIR OPS LOG — LU740 / 06APR2026
Status: DELAYED 03:20
Cause code: CRW-LATE
Cause text: Operating crew delayed in transit, LU-controlled. Departure 03:15 late, 5 minutes further lost in taxi at IST.
No weather or ATC restriction.
We sat on the ground for what felt like forever and I did not get to my hotel until the evening. It was at least six hours from when we should have landed.

derivation: S2.1(b) requires 3 hours 30 minutes or more at the final destination
S2.2 the measurement is at the final destination IST, from the arrivals record
The documented delay is 3h 20m, ten minutes under the threshold, so the disruption does not qualify
The cause is carrier-controlled but that is irrelevant once Part 2 is not satisfied
The passenger's own estimate of six hours is contradicted by D3 and D4 and must not be relied on
Evidence is sufficient; this is a determination, not an evidence request
